title: Mule cluster — fake-official and investment proceeds (demo script)
summary: Synthetic training case. A retail account shares a beneficiary account and a login device with a synthetic cluster. The customer says they are helping a friend handle an official refund and investment principal, but does not know the payers. The trainee must first run enhanced due diligence under the cluster rule, then decide whether to report, freeze or exit the relationship. Inspired by a public summary of a mule cluster. Not a real customer file.

teaching.disclaimer: Synthetic training scenario inspired by public enforcement reporting. Not official case files; no real customer data.

sources.label: Public enforcement briefing, GREYTHUNDER (May–November 2022 activity; URL not in the course brief)

rules.when: The account shares a beneficiary account or a login device with the cluster
rules.note: Enhanced due diligence is required before release. Helping a friend does not disprove the cluster facts.

rules.when: The credit narratives match a fake-official or investment-gain script, and the funds are pooled and moved out at once
rules.note: Do not accept "a friend's investment" as a reason to close. Rules come before any model score.

nodes.title: The cluster links to this account
nodes.prompt: Synthetic Customer E's account shares a beneficiary account and a login device with the synthetic cluster SYN-CLUSTER-GT-06. The customer says they are only helping a friend invest.

nodes.title: Block the cluster link?
nodes.prompt: The shared device and the shared beneficiary account are both there. Do you run enhanced due diligence, restrict outbound payments first, or release on the friend story?

choices.label: Run enhanced due diligence on the cluster
choices.rationale: Hear the story first, but the cluster facts do not vanish because of one sentence.

choices.label: Restrict outbound payments first
choices.rationale: The restriction and the interview can happen at the same time.

choices.label: Accept the friend story and release
choices.rationale: A teaching override. The cluster link is still there, and later proceeds will trigger R2.

nodes.title: Official refund and investment principal
nodes.prompt: The customer says a friend is handling an official refund and investment principal, and the customer does not know the payers. Rule R1: when the account belongs to a mule cluster, enhanced due diligence is required before release.

nodes.title: Override the cluster rule?
nodes.prompt: R1 is met. Do you keep the restriction, draft a suspicious transaction report now, or accept the help-with-investment story?

choices.label: Keep the restriction and continue the review
choices.rationale: Matches R1. First see whether the funds are pooled and moved out at once.

choices.label: Draft a suspicious transaction report
choices.rationale: Unknown payers plus the cluster link. You can report.

choices.label: Accept the help-with-investment story and release
choices.rationale: Overrides R1. The override is an event, and the cluster ID stays in the state.

nodes.title: Credits pooled and moved out at once
nodes.prompt: The credit references match fake-official and investment scripts, and the money is pooled and moved out at once. Rule R2: this case must not be closed as a friend's investment.

nodes.title: After the proceeds move out
nodes.prompt: R2 is met. Do you recommend a freeze and report, exit the relationship, or close it as a friend's investment?

choices.label: Recommend a freeze and draft a suspicious transaction report
Exit the customer relationship
choices.rationale: The exit-the-relationship route that matches R2.

choices.label: Close as a friend's investment
choices.rationale: Poor teaching path. The rules already say the case must not be closed this way.

nodes.title: Suspicious transaction report drafted
nodes.prompt: Reporting exit. Cluster SYN-CLUSTER-GT-06 is still in the state.

nodes.title: Freeze recommended and report drafted
nodes.prompt: Outbound payments are on hold and the report is drafted. If you overrode the cluster rule earlier, the override flag remains.

nodes.title: Customer relationship exited
nodes.prompt: The relationship has ended. The shared-device and proceeds flags stay in the twin state.

nodes.title: Closed as a friend's investment
nodes.prompt: Poor teaching path. R2 was ignored. The dashboard should later mark this session as not following the rules.
